integrity: All computations were obtained using exact rational arithmetic from a standalone exhaustive enumeration of 146598 matchings through seven chords; the analytic proof covers all integers n>=2 and asymptotic claims. Numerical enumeration alone would not prove all-n claims.
scientific_limitations: Uniform matchings of fixed cyclic endpoints only. The exact sum and sharp asymptotic are proved analytically; independent proof audit has not been performed. Possible implicit coverage by older multivariate matching enumerations is not excluded.
title: A nonvanishing crossing-covariance footprint of rare isolated chords
